info.about: Silent Hill: Shattered Memories is a 2009 survival horror game developed by Climax Studios and published by Konami. It was released in December for the Wii and ported to the PlayStation 2 and PlayStation Portable platforms in January 2010.
info.trivia: A reimagining of the first Silent Hill, it was the first game in the series to make heavy use of dynamic music, composed by Akira Yamaoka.
info.why: The last Silent Hill released on PS2, it arrived in January 2010, more than three years after the PS3 launched, when the PS2 disc market was winding down.
